newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates dip on surplus funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates dip on surplus funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates dipped on Monday on surplus funds, dealers said.

The market was left surplus after the State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) picked up 500 million rupees in a special open market operation at 15.70 cut-off, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Deals were finalised between 15.25 and 17.75 percent before the operation, the dealer said. The rates dropped to three percent after the SBP announced the operation's result.
The market closed with surplus funds and no discounting was done with the SBP, the dealer said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
